prompt: A pull request description ends with `Closes #12`. What happens?
explanation: Closing keywords link the pull request to the issue so the issue shuts automatically on merge — into the default branch specifically. Opening the PR alone leaves the issue open.

options.text: Issue #12 automatically closes when the pull request merges into the default branch
Issue #12 closes the moment the pull request is opened
The pull request merges itself when issue #12 is closed
